newsitem.title: SPAIN: Antena 3 chairman resigns after Telefonica deal.
newsitem.headline: Antena 3 chairman resigns after Telefonica deal.

text.p: Antonio Asensio resigned on Monday as chairman of Spain's Antena 3, the television station said in a statement.

Six other board members also resigned after Spanish telecoms provider Telefonica announced a deal to buy 25 percent of Antena 3 and a controlling stake in its GMA subsidiary, which has lucrative rights to broadcast soccer matches.
The Telefonica/Antena 3 agreement also includes Spanish banks BCH and Santander, which are taking 7.14 percent and 11.58 percent of Antena 3 respectively, and one percent each of GMA.
